set.tovw: Found: the 1924 court record accounts for the whole sum
set.n: Stolen farm money near Beaver: recovered 1924; 1925 'still buried' claim dug without result
set.st: A daughter took the family's $11,000 savings in 1924. After her arrest $6,000 was dug up on the farm and she admitted investing the rest, though a 1925 wire story claimed more was still buried and 22 men dug for it without result. Pin is on the 1912 house mark, a recovered-find record.
set.t: Recovered-find record: the court record accounts for all the money. Private farmland: permission.
